FN-PSSUBRR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 217
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/17/2025
Senate Bill 217 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Examiners of
Public Accounts by a small undetermined amount to keep bond financing review forms
submitted by municipalities prior to entering into a bond financing agreements, including
SWAP agreements, on file and available for public inspection for a period of seven years.
